g.text: MVC Pane Lifecycle — Sprint 0 Task B5
View (otmux) must notify Controller (hiveMind) on pane mutations
Model (claudeCode) is unaffected — sessions are bound to TTYs, not pane indices
Please use CSS style instead of skinparam ParticipantPadding
Pane operations do NOT notify Controller.
1. Registry unchanged → resolve returns wrong pane
2. Pane titles unchanged → visual labels lie
Pane operations notify Controller via protected methods.
Registry stays consistent. resolve returns correct targets.
Three things must update on swap:
claudeCode sessions are bound to TTYs, not pane indices.
When panes split/swap/move, the Claude process stays on its TTY.
The TTY→pane mapping changes (tmux renumbers), but the process doesn't move.
claudeCode.session.id uses: ps args → sessions.env → JSONL
None of these reference pane indices — they use TTY or UUID.
Model is portable. Only View↔Controller binding needs fixing.
New hiveMind protected methods for otmux to call:
— re-scan pane list, remap registry by TTY matching
— called after: split, kill (any op that renumbers)
— remove from source, add to target session
Guard: command -v hiveMind >/dev/null (otmux works without hiveMind)
